WHY: the original preregistration was destroyed with the container after its first numbers had already been seen. See RPP97_STATEMENT.md section 0. Everything below describes; nothing below confirms or refutes the mechanism.

1_S1_IS_NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_THESE_ARCHIVES.READING: the bodies that divide in these worlds are one to four cells across. A core cannot be told from a rim on an object of one cell. This is NOT evidence against the core-depletion mechanism; it is the finding that the mechanism's PRECONDITION — an extended spot with an interior — does not hold here. The Gray-Scott spot-replication picture describes a body large enough to have a starved centre. At the scale where division happens in these worlds there is no interior to starve.

2_S2_RUNS_OPPOSITE_TO_THE_PREDICTION.sign_convention: positive means the neighbourhood is RICHER in X than the lattice average. The mechanism predicted NEGATIVE.
2_S2_RUNS_OPPOSITE_TO_THE_PREDICTION.THE_TRIVIAL_EXPLANATION_THAT_IS_NOT_AVAI: a global collapse of X would inflate S2 mechanically. It did not happen: nX_total RISES over these windows (7 at t=0, 272 at t_m-250, 252 at t_m-1 in the archive checked). So the positive sign is not an artefact of a falling denominator.
2_S2_RUNS_OPPOSITE_TO_THE_PREDICTION.THE_EXPLANATION_THAT_IS_AVAILABLE_AND_IS: Y birth requires nX AND nY together (propensity kY*nX*nY). Bodies therefore SIT where X is abundant — they are found in rich neighbourhoods rather than making them rich. S2 as defined cannot separate 'the body enriches its surroundings' from 'the body is where the surroundings were already rich'. Separating them needs control discs placed elsewhere at the same step, which is NOT in the statement and would be post-hoc on top of post-hoc. It is named, not performed.

3_A_DESIGN_DEFECT_I_FOUND_IN_MY_OWN_STAT.what: the statement announced a between-arm control across SHAM, SELECTIVE and DISPLACED. The numbers are IDENTICAL across the three arms, to the decimal, in both windows.
3_A_DESIGN_DEFECT_I_FOUND_IN_MY_OWN_STAT.why: both windows, FAR [t_m-2000, t_m-1000] and PRE [t_m-250, t_m-1], lie entirely BEFORE t_m — before the fork. The three arms share one common prefix, so they cannot differ there. The between-arm control is empty BY CONSTRUCTION.
3_A_DESIGN_DEFECT_I_FOUND_IN_MY_OWN_STAT.consequence: the identical columns are a consistency check on the archives, not a result. Any future version of this comparison must place at least one window AFTER t_m to have an arm contrast at all.
3_A_DESIGN_DEFECT_I_FOUND_IN_MY_OWN_STAT.found_by: me, before the adversarial checker was called. It is written here rather than waiting to be caught.

4_WHAT_THIS_DESCRIBES: the division events in these worlds are not the division of an extended spot with a depleted core. They occur in objects of one to four cells, and the local X field around them is richer than the lattice average rather than poorer. Whether that richness is cause, consequence or mere co-location is NOT determined here.
5_WHAT_A_REAL_TEST_WOULD_NEED: a preregistration written before any number is seen, on archives not yet looked at
at least one window after t_m, or the arm contrast stays empty
control discs at the same step to separate co-location from enrichment
a mechanism statement whose precondition is checked first: is the dividing body extended at all?
LIMITS_CARRIED_FROM_THE_STATEMENT: c_nX exists only on Y-occupied cells, so S1 measures the inside of the body and not the medium; no radial profile outside the body is reconstructible.
